title: 第5章 柳家来迎亲第6章 和江海市第一美女柳云烟成婚
content_zh:
老爷子发怒，餐厅里的气氛再次降到冰点。
吴振南连忙打圆场：“哎呀，都是孩子，童言无忌，童言无忌嘛。景言，别哭了，地上的筷子脏了，让保姆再给你换一双。”
他示意旁边的保姆赶紧处理。
陈景言这才抽抽噎噎地停下了哭声，可怜巴巴地看着众人，那副受了委屈的模样，倒真有几分惹人怜爱。
一顿饭就在这样诡异而压抑的气氛中草草结束。陈景言吃得肚子滚圆，被史云书“哄”回了二楼房间。
房门再次关上，陈景言脸上的痴傻和委屈瞬间褪去，他走到窗边，看着庭院里逐渐熄灭的灯火，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
“柳云烟……瘸子母老虎……明天，我倒要亲自见识见识。”
他低声自语，眼中闪烁着玩味的光芒。
这场戏，才刚刚开始。而他这个“傻子”新郎，明天就要正式登场了。
一大早，佣人就拿着一套红色的礼服让他穿着进入柳家。
陈景言看到这个佣人是一个四十多岁的中年妇女，应该是一个老实人，他便拉着佣人的手坐下来，问道：“阿姨，吴家为什么不要我，我不是他们亲生的吗？”
佣人走过去把门关上，回来在陈景言身旁重新坐下来，把她知道的事情告诉了陈景言。
陈景言生在江海市豪门吴家，一生下来，背部就有一个血红色的胎记。有一天，有一个道士来到吴家，说此子是天煞孤星，会让吴家家破人亡。
三个月的陈景言就被亲生父母用五千万订单作为交换条件，把他送给江海市的三流世家陈家抚养，后来道士给吴家送来一个孩子，说是此子命带福星，能给吴家带来泼天的富贵。
这就是后来被吴家宠上天的养子吴子毅。
佣人说的和陈景言的养父说的高度吻合，应该是真的。这一点，陈景言深信不疑。
佣人接着说出陈景言不知道的事情。
陈家对陈景言这个养子很好，自从他离开陈家到处游历，偶尔回来一趟，陈家人对他依旧视如珍宝，每逢年节总在祠堂为他点一盏长明灯。
陈景言每一次回来，陈家人都舍不得他走，可他每一次都执意离开，仿佛有很多事情等着他去办。
只是他在外面做些什么，陈家人都不知道。

直到三年前，陈景言衣衫褴褛回到陈家，他成了傻子。
没有人知道他经历了什么，更没有人知道他怎么成傻子了。
佣人说得很有耐心。
陈景言依旧装作傻傻的样子继续问：“柳家大小姐柳云烟是个丑八怪，母老虎。她会打断别人的腿，还把人关在地下室......”
“没有的事。”佣人打断陈景言的话，继续说：“我没见过，但据说柳云烟是江海市最漂亮的美女总裁，只是她性格孤僻，冷酷无情，不喜与人来往，整日坐在轮椅上处理公司事务。她双腿不能行走，却掌控着整个柳氏集团的命脉，手段凌厉，决策果决，连商界老狐狸都忌惮三分。”
那就更奇怪了，既然是江海市的第一美女，怎么会嫁给自己这个傻子呢？
“柳云烟喜欢傻子，嘿嘿嘿，她有病，喜欢傻子。”
陈景言心中冷笑，面上却依旧憨笑不止。
佣人叹了口气，轻轻拍了拍陈景言的手背：“有些事，不是你这傻子能懂的。”
content_en:
The old man became angry and the atmosphere in the restaurant dropped to freezing point again.
Wu Zhennan quickly smoothed things over: "Oh, they are all children. Children's words are unbridled, children's words are unbridled. Jing Yan, stop crying. The chopsticks on the floor are dirty. Ask the nanny to change another pair for you."
He motioned to the nanny next to him to deal with it quickly.
Chen Jingyan stopped crying with sobs and looked at everyone pitifully. His aggrieved look was quite endearing.
The meal ended hastily in such a strange and depressing atmosphere. Chen Jingyan's stomach was full after eating, and he was "coaxed" back to his room on the second floor by Shi Yunshu.
The door closed again, and the stupidity and grievance on Chen Jingyan's face instantly faded away. He walked to the window and looked at the lights gradually extinguishing in the courtyard, with a cold arc at the corner of his mouth.
"Liu Yunyan...the lame tigress...tomorrow, I want to see it for myself."
He whispered to himself, his eyes twinkling with amusement.
This drama has just begun. And his "idiot" groom will make his official debut tomorrow.
Early in the morning, the servant brought a red dress for him to wear into Liu's house.
Chen Jingyan saw that the servant was a middle-aged woman in her forties, who should be an honest person, so he took the servant's hand, sat down, and asked: "Auntie, why don't the Wu family want me? Am I not their biological child?"
The servant walked over and closed the door, came back and sat down next to Chen Jingyan again, and told Chen Jingyan what she knew.
Chen Jingyan was born into the wealthy Wu family in Jianghai City. He had a blood-red birthmark on his back from birth. One day, a Taoist priest came to the Wu family and said that this son was a lone star of evil that would destroy the Wu family.
When Chen Jingyan was three months old, his biological parents gave him an order of 50 million in exchange for raising him in the Chen family, a third-rate family in Jianghai City. Later, a Taoist priest sent a child to the Wu family, saying that the child was destined to have a lucky star and would bring the Wu family great wealth.
This was Wu Ziyi, the adopted son who was later favored by the Wu family.
What the servant said was very consistent with what Chen Jingyan's adoptive father said, so it should be true. Chen Jingyan firmly believed in this.
The servant then told something that Chen Jingyan didn't know.
The Chen family is very good to their adopted son Chen Jingyan. Since he left the Chen family and traveled around, and occasionally came back, the Chen family still regards him as a treasure and always light an ever-burning lantern for him in the ancestral hall every New Year.
Every time Chen Jingyan came back, the Chen family was reluctant to let him go, but he insisted on leaving every time, as if there were many things waiting for him to do.
It's just that the Chen family doesn't know what he is doing outside.
Until three years ago, when Chen Jingyan returned to the Chen family in ragged clothes, he became a fool.
No one knows what he went through, and no one knows how he became such a fool.
The servant spoke very patiently.
Chen Jingyan still pretended to be stupid and continued to ask: "The eldest lady of the Liu family, Liu Yunyan, is an ugly tigress. She breaks other people's legs and locks them in the basement..."
"Nothing." The servant interrupted Chen Jingyan and continued: "I have never seen her, but it is said that Liu Yunyan is the most beautiful CEO in Jianghai City. However, she is withdrawn, cold-hearted, and does not like to interact with others. She sits in a wheelchair all day long to deal with company affairs. She cannot walk, but she controls the lifeblood of the entire Liu Group. She is fierce in her methods and decisive in decision-making. Even the old foxes in the business world are afraid of her."
That's even more strange. Since she is the most beautiful woman in Jianghai City, why would she marry a fool like herself?
"Liu Yunyan likes fools, hehehe, she is sick and likes fools."
Chen Jingyan sneered in his heart, but his face still kept smiling.
The servant sighed and patted the back of Chen Jingyan's hand gently: "There are some things that a fool like you can't understand."
